borders.label: 边框 2 - Border 2
borders.description: The palette is almost aggressively monochrome. Pure black (`#000000`) and pure white (`#FFFFFF`) do the vast majority of the work — CTAs, text, backgrounds, map pins — and the result is a UI that feels more like signage than software. When color appears it is functional, never decorative: green (`#05A357`) means "your driver is here" or "confirmed", red (`#D72113`) means "surge" or "cancel", blue (`#0A47FF`) means "info" or "Business profile", amber (`#FFCB00`) means "high surge". There are no gradients, no glows, no skeuomorphic touches. Surfaces are flat; elevation is expressed by a single hairline and a shadow so subtle it reads more as a seam than a drop.

borders.label: 边框 3 - Border 3
borders.description: Gray 50 (`#F6F6F6`): Light surface, secondary sheet background, disabled fills.

panels.title: 面向真实界面片段
panels.body: 按钮、输入、卡片和间距样例保持克制，便于比较不同主题的系统性差异。

do: 建议：Keep the map at 60%+ of viewport on every primary screen。
建议：Use pure {#000000} for primary CTAs, destination pin, and active bottom-tab icon。
建议：Render the "Where to?" bottom sheet with 16pt top-corner radius and visible grabber。
建议：Use Uber Move Mono for every ETA, fare, and address — never the body text cut。
建议：Reserve green {#05A357} for "driver arrived" and "confirmed" states only。
dont: 避免：add gradients, glows, or glossy effects — Uber's chrome is flat, period。
避免：color primary CTAs — the primary button is always black, never branded green or blue。
避免：use green or red outside their semantic roles (success / destructive) — they lose meaning。
避免：round bottom sheet corners on all four sides — only top corners, bottom is flush。
避免：use drop shadows heavier than 0.25 opacity anywhere — elevation stays whisper-quiet。
